title: SaveKeyMaterialMintResult
description: Result of the secrets.saveKeyMaterial JSON-RPC method: a private key minted into the vault, addressed by the renderer's row handle, with the parse results the editor acts on (fingerprint, and whether a passphrase is wanted).

row.description: The renderer-addressable row handle of the minted secret (secrow:...). Never a secret reference — the renderer may not hold one (ADR-0011 §2).

fingerprint.description: SHA256 fingerprint of the stored key. Empty when the key is encrypted in a traditional PEM envelope whose public half is behind the passphrase — unknown-until-unlocked, not absent.

passphraseWanted.description: True when the stored key is encrypted and no passphrase for it is stored yet. The renderer must ask for the key's passphrase then and there — a wrong one is refused against the key.
